title: 'Whose Ground' at the Fallows completes the instant you press Frey (the Keeper) on her identity, before ever meeting the surveyor, recruiter, or Sister Merrow, even though its own description promises 'A surveyor, a recruiter, a sister, and a stranger all want a say.' The choice's consequences do land correctly afterward in the separate Surveyor's Stakes, Muster in the Barn, and Long Furrow quests, so it's a sequencing/framing mismatch rather than a broken choice.
where: Wickstead Crossroads (Fallows), talk to Frey, 'the barrow-keepers, in the old tongue' branch
